[[File:Linda BW057.png|thumb|250px|Linda]] '''Linda''' (Japanese: '''リンダ''' ''Linda'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW057|The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!]]''. She is a childhood friend of [[Charles]] and is well aware he is in fact the Mighty Accelguard. Linda stopped a lone thief with her {{p|Timburr}} after the Mighty Accelguard failed to do so because of his clumsiness. Later, she picked up a few leads about the {{p|Vanillite}} trucks seen in the area and went to the [[Cold Storage]] alone to investigate. There, she was confronted by [[Dr. Ferrara]] and [[Dr. Ferrara's henchmen|his henchmen]], and captured. She was later saved by Charles, who was assisted by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. When Ferrara made his escape, Linda followed behind Mighty Accelguard in a truck with Ash and his friends while she contacted [[Officer Jenny]]. She also helped stop Ferrara's henchmen and their Vanillite. Linda enjoys teasing Charles about his clumsiness. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Linda |pkmn=Timburr |img=Linda Timburr.png |type1=Fighting |epnum=BW057 |epname=The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Timburr}} is the only known Pokémon Linda has on hand. It helps her fight crime in [[Driftveil City]].
